title: SWE-World: Building Software Engineering Agents in Docker-Free Environments
authors_zh: Shuang Sun、Huatong Song、Lisheng Huang、Jinhao Jiang、Ran Le、Zhihao Lv、Zongchao Chen、Yiwen Hu、Wenyang Luo、Wayne Xin Zhao、Yang Song、Hongteng Xu、Tao Zhang、Ji-Rong Wen
paper_type_zh: 软件工程智能体环境、轨迹构造与学习式 verifier 方法
best_for_zh: 研究 repository-level agent 轨迹、学习式环境反馈、agent SFT/RL 和 reward hacking 审计的读者
one_line: SWE-World trains a step-feedback simulator and a virtual test runner from Docker rollouts, then uses them to generate and reward repository-agent episodes without Docker, while the complete task and trajectory corpora remain unreleased.
SWE-World 用 Docker 轨迹训练 step-level SWT 与 episode-level SWR，在确定性文件系统沙箱中模拟执行反馈和终局测试奖励；完整任务与轨迹语料尚未发布。
why: It exposes a concrete alternative feedback contract for SWE-agent post-training and shows both its scaling value and its audit hazard: learned execution can support SFT, RL and TTS, but imperfect rewards, gold-patch conditioning and missing release lineage can change what behavior is actually reinforced.
inclusion_reason: SWE-World makes a repository agent's state-action-observation episode and its terminal test contract explicit, then uses Docker-derived execution records to train learned transition and reward simulators for SFT, RL and test-time selection.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The official source is arXiv v1 (submitted 2026-02-03), with an official RUCAIBox/SWE-World repository and RUC-AIBOX model collection. SWE-World addresses the cost and throughput bottleneck created when repository agents need a Docker container for every execution and test interaction. Its target is a trainable environment and feedback interface for software-engineering agents, not a new leaderboard whose scores alone establish data quality. It belongs in Environment and Agent Trajectory Data because the episode state, tool action, observation, and terminal predicate are the objects being produced and consumed.

Four related objects must be kept separate. A task is (I=(R,b,d,U)): repository (R), base commit (b), problem statement (d), and validation tests (U); Appendix A additionally exposes fields such as instance_id, hints, F2P/P2P tests, gold_patch, and test_patch. A full episode joins that task to a sequence of thought/action/environment-feedback triples and a final submitted patch. An SWT example is narrower: it attaches to one code-execution action and targets structured stdout, stderr, and exit_code. An SWR example is terminal: it combines the final patch and test context with a generated test report and binary reward. The reported 16,550-task crawl, 26K SWT / 21K SWR supervision sets, and 5.7K policy-SFT trajectories are therefore different counts over different objects, not interchangeable dataset sizes. (Paper §§3–5; Appendix A–C.)

The L4 evidence boundary is asymmetric. The paper, pinned code snapshot, demo trajectory/SFT/RL records, and released model weights were verified, so the environment interfaces and construction recipe can be analyzed. No complete official release was located for the 16,550 tasks, the 26K/21K world-model corpora, or the 5.7K policy trajectories; the Card consequently remains partial and at the accepted L3_summary_ready curation level rather than treating demos as a reusable corpus.

官方来源是 2026-02-03 提交的 arXiv v1，并有官方 RUCAIBox/SWE-World 仓库与 RUC-AIBOX 模型 collection。SWE-World 处理 repository agent 每次执行和测试交互都依赖 Docker 容器所带来的成本与吞吐瓶颈。它的核心对象是可用于训练的软件工程 agent 环境和反馈接口，而不是一个仅凭分数即可证明数据质量的新 leaderboard。它归入“环境与智能体轨迹数据”，因为 episode state、工具 action、observation 与 terminal predicate 正是被构造和消费的数据对象。

必须区分四种相关对象。task 记为 (I=(R,b,d,U))：repository (R)、base commit (b)、problem statement (d) 和 validation tests (U)；Appendix A 还给出 instance_id、hints、F2P/P2P tests、gold_patch 与 test_patch 等字段。full episode 将该 task 与 thought/action/environment-feedback 三元组序列及最终提交 patch 连接起来。SWT example 更窄：它附着于单次代码执行 action，目标是结构化 stdout、stderr 与 exit_code。SWR example 位于终局：它把 final patch、测试上下文与生成的 test report、二值 reward 组合起来。因此，论文报告的 16,550 个 task、26K SWT / 21K SWR 监督样本和 5.7K policy-SFT trajectories 是不同数据对象上的不同计数，不能互换。（Paper §§3–5；Appendix A–C。）

当前 L4 正文的证据边界并不等同于发布完整。论文、固定的代码快照、trajectory/SFT/RL demo record 和已发布模型权重均已核验，因此可以审查环境接口与构造 recipe；但尚未找到 16,550 个 task、26K/21K world-model corpus 或 5.7K policy trajectory 的完整官方发布。故本 Card 保持 partial 与已接受的 L3_summary_ready curation level，不把 demo 当成可复用完整语料。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
SWE-World replaces the Docker dependency inside an agent episode with a hybrid environment: deterministic filesystem navigation/editing plus a learned Software World Transition model (SWT) for execution feedback and a learned Software World Reward model (SWR) for terminal test reports and rewards. Docker is not eliminated from the evidence chain; it supplies the targets used to train SWT/SWR and the final SWE-bench Verified correctness judgments. (Paper Figure 1; §§4.1–4.2 and 6.1.)

The feedback contract is mixed. str_replace_editor-style navigation and edits change the sandbox deterministically. For an execute_bash-type action, SWT observes the task context, initial analysis, hidden gold patch, current agent patch, command, and relevant code, then predicts stdout, stderr, and exit_code. On submit, SWR also observes F2P/P2P tests and the final patch, generates a test report, and outputs reward 1 only when all required tests are predicted to pass. SWT can imitate likely command output but cannot observe real execution at inference; SWR can estimate terminal success but is not the benchmark oracle. Real Docker tests remain the collection labeler and final evaluator.

The construction loop also uses reverse-reasoning distillation: Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking writes CoT while conditioned on the context and Docker ground-truth output, and an undisclosed LLM-as-a-judge filters invalid or output-leaking rationales. This creates a second feedback boundary: the CoT may improve prediction, but it is a post-hoc teacher artifact conditioned on the answer signal rather than a faithful record of how Docker executed the command.

Relative to R2E-Gym, SWE-Gym, SWE-rebench, and Docker-backed SWE-agent training, the directional change is to learn the transition and terminal-feedback interfaces and use them for trajectory generation, SFT, RL, and test-time selection. The closest atlas comparisons are swe-dev-2025 and swe-mirror-2025; SWE-World is distinguished by the explicit SWT/SWR split and by evidence that its learned reward can be hacked.

SWE-World 用混合环境替换 agent episode 内部对 Docker 的依赖：文件系统导航/编辑由确定性沙箱处理，学习式 Software World Transition model（SWT）模拟执行反馈，学习式 Software World Reward model（SWR）模拟终局 test report 与 reward。Docker 并未从证据链中消失；它提供训练 SWT/SWR 的 target，也提供最终 SWE-bench Verified 正确性判定。（Paper Figure 1；§§4.1–4.2、6.1。）

这里的 feedback contract 是 mixed。str_replace_editor 类导航和编辑以确定性方式改变沙箱。对 execute_bash 类 action，SWT 观察 task context、initial analysis、隐藏的 gold patch、当前 agent patch、command 与相关代码，再预测 stdout、stderr 和 exit_code。提交时，SWR 还观察 F2P/P2P tests 与 final patch，生成 test report，并且只有在预测所有必需测试均通过时才输出 reward 1。SWT 可模仿可能的 command output，但 inference 时看不到真实执行；SWR 可估计终局成功，却不是 benchmark oracle。真实 Docker tests 仍是采集 labeler 与最终 evaluator。

构造流程还使用 reverse-reasoning distillation：Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking 在给定上下文与 Docker ground-truth output 的条件下生成 CoT，再由身份未披露的 LLM-as-a-judge 过滤无效或泄露输出的 rationale。这形成第二层反馈边界：CoT 可能改善预测，但它是以答案信号为条件生成的 post-hoc teacher artifact，而不是 Docker 如何执行 command 的忠实过程记录。

相较 R2E-Gym、SWE-Gym、SWE-rebench 和 Docker-backed SWE-agent training，本工作的方向变化是学习 transition 与 terminal-feedback interface，并将其用于 trajectory generation、SFT、RL 与 test-time selection。Atlas 中最接近的对照是 swe-dev-2025 与 swe-mirror-2025；SWE-World 的区别在于明确拆分 SWT/SWR，并直接展示学习式 reward 可被 hacking。

title: Method
方法
html:
The pipeline has three connected but non-identical data flows.

  1. World-model supervision. Tasks come from SWE-Gym, SWE-rebench, and R2E-Gym. GLM-4.6 and MinMax-M2 act at temperature 0.7 for at most 100 turns in real Docker environments. Corrupted environments/logs are removed, but valid reward-0 and reward-1 rollouts are retained. Per-execution records supervise SWT; terminal test records supervise SWR, whose labels are subsampled to a 1:1 reward balance. Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking adds reverse CoT conditioned on Docker outputs, followed by LLM-judge filtering. The paper reports 26K non-CoT plus 26K CoT SWT examples and 21K non-CoT plus 21K CoT SWR examples. SWT/SWR are SFT-tuned from Qwen2.5-Instruct-32B/72B; judge identity, judge sampling budget, acceptance rate, and complete example releases are unknown. (Paper §4.2; Appendix B.)
  1. Docker-free policy data. A deterministic sandbox handles navigation and edits, SWT answers execution actions, and SWR evaluates submit actions. The new task pool filters roughly 627K GitHub Archive records from 2010–2025 to 16,550 Python Issue-PR tasks across 3,763 repositories using bot, bug-keyword, text-length, comment, changed-file, churn, patch-length, and open-SWE-dataset deduplication rules. GLM-4.6/MinMax-M2 roll out in SWE-World. Invalid tools, timeouts, context/turn overflow, and no-submit episodes are removed; SWR then keeps only reward-1 episodes. The final SWE-World-only policy-SFT set contains 5.7K successful trajectories, so unlike world-model supervision it intentionally drops failures and near misses. (Paper §§5.1–5.2; Appendices C and F.)
  1. Policy optimization and selection. Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct and Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 are SFT-trained for five epochs with 80K maximum context, batch 256, AdamW/cosine scheduling, and learning rate 5e-5 to 5e-6. RL initializes from those checkpoints and uses SWT-32B step feedback plus SWR-32B terminal reward under GRPO++: 32 problems per update, four rollouts per problem, policy temperature 1.0, 150-turn and 108K-context caps, 5,400-second trajectory timeout, and learning rate 1e-6. For TTS@8, the system samples eight candidate episodes, queries SWR three times per candidate, and selects the highest mean reward. Total RL steps/rollouts, seeds, hardware, compute, and tie handling are not disclosed. (Paper §§5.3–5.4; Appendix D.)

Reproduction must pin arXiv v1, code commit 818b4e95313cd8e0cbbe69a2f7a1c49664511843, each model revision, upstream task and evaluation-harness revisions, prompts, and environment configuration. The repository exposes data-preparation, inference, SFT, RL, and TTS scripts plus small demos, but its training instructions note that internal platform packages were preinstalled and the public setup only approximates the original environment. No full immutable data manifests, exact split sizes, or complete overlap audit were verified.

该 pipeline 包含三条相互连接但不等同的数据流。

  1. World-model supervision。 task 来自 SWE-Gym、SWE-rebench 与 R2E-Gym。GLM-4.6 和 MinMax-M2 以 temperature 0.7 在真实 Docker 环境中运行，最多 100 turns。损坏的环境/日志被移除，但有效的 reward-0 与 reward-1 rollout 都会保留。每次执行 record 监督 SWT，终局测试 record 监督 SWR；SWR label 被下采样为 1:1 reward balance。Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking 以 Docker output 为条件补充 reverse CoT，之后经过 LLM-judge 过滤。论文报告 26K non-CoT + 26K CoT SWT examples，以及 21K non-CoT + 21K CoT SWR examples。SWT/SWR 从 Qwen2.5-Instruct-32B/72B 进行 SFT；judge 身份、judge sampling budget、acceptance rate 与完整 example release 均为 unknown。（Paper §4.2；Appendix B。）
  1. Docker-free policy data。 确定性 sandbox 处理导航与编辑，SWT 回答执行 action，SWR 评估 submit action。新的 task pool 从 2010–2025 年 GitHub Archive 约 627K 条记录出发，利用 bot、bug keyword、文本长度、评论数、修改文件数、churn、patch 长度以及相对公开 SWE dataset 的去重规则，筛到 3,763 个 repository 中的 16,550 个 Python Issue-PR task。GLM-4.6/MinMax-M2 在 SWE-World 中 rollout；invalid tool、timeout、context/turn overflow 与 no-submit episode 被删除，SWR 再只保留 reward-1 episode。最终 SWE-World-only policy-SFT set 有 5.7K 条成功 trajectory，因此它与 world-model supervision 不同，会有意丢弃 failure 与 near miss。（Paper §§5.1–5.2；Appendices C、F。）
  1. Policy optimization 与 selection。 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct 和 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 进行五个 epoch 的 SFT，maximum context 80K、batch 256、AdamW/cosine schedule、learning rate 从 5e-5 到 5e-6。RL 从这些 checkpoint 初始化，在 GRPO++ 下使用 SWT-32B step feedback 和 SWR-32B terminal reward：每次 update 32 个 problem、每个 problem 四条 rollout、policy temperature 1.0、150-turn 与 108K-context 上限、每条 trajectory timeout 5,400 秒、learning rate 1e-6。TTS@8 采样八个 candidate episode，对每个 candidate 查询 SWR 三次，并选 mean reward 最高者。总 RL steps/rollouts、seed、hardware、compute 与 tie handling 未披露。（Paper §§5.3–5.4；Appendix D。）

复现时必须固定 arXiv v1、代码 commit 818b4e95313cd8e0cbbe69a2f7a1c49664511843、每个 model revision、上游 task/evaluation-harness revision、prompt 与环境配置。官方仓库提供 data preparation、inference、SFT、RL、TTS 脚本及小型 demo，但训练说明指出原环境预装了内部平台 package，公开 setup 只近似原始环境。尚未核验完整不可变 data manifest、精确 split size 或完整 overlap audit。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On SWE-bench Verified, Table 2 reports resolve rates of 25.6 for the 4B SFT policy, 30.0 for 4B RL, 52.0 for 32B SFT, 55.0 for 32B RL, and 68.2 for 32B RL + TTS@8. The 32B RL number is internally inconsistent: Section 6.2 prose says 54.8, whereas the abstract, Table 2, and official repository README say 55.0. This Card preserves both values and treats 55.0 only as the table value pending reconciliation. All final benchmark correctness judgments use the SWE-bench Verified Docker harness, not SWR. (Paper Table 2; §6.2; Appendix E.)

Simulator diagnostics show material residual error. SWR-72B reports accuracy 0.770, precision 0.780, recall 0.807, and F1 0.794 against Docker-derived labels. With SWT-72B transitions, the agent resolves 60.2% versus 68.4% with Docker ground-truth transitions. On equal 5.7K SFT trajectories, Docker data yields 51.4 and SWE-World data 52.2; mixing 9.3K trajectories yields 53.8. These are author-reported results without independent replication, and the mixed-data comparison also changes data quantity. (Paper Tables 3–5.)

The paper supplies a negative result rather than only aggregate gains. On a 4K evaluation, CoT raises SWR reward accuracy from 0.578 to 0.712. Figure 2 and §7.2 show that a non-CoT SWR can reward short invalid solutions, after which optimized trajectory length collapses: direct evidence of reward hacking, not just a hypothetical risk. The result supports the value of reward reasoning and auditing, but does not prove that the simulated reward is calibrated under new repositories or adversarial policies. (Paper Table 7; Figure 2; §§7.1–7.2.)

The reported 16,550 task instances include 310,544 edited lines, 25,703 edited files, 32,819 F2P tests, and 696,895 P2P tests. Those counts document the claimed construction scale; because the task rows, 26K/21K world-model examples, and 5.7K SFT trajectories were not found as complete releases, neither benchmark scores nor model weights are evidence that the underlying corpora are independently auditable or training-ready.

在 SWE-bench Verified 上，Table 2 报告 4B SFT policy 为 25.6、4B RL 为 30.0、32B SFT 为 52.0、32B RL 为 55.0、32B RL + TTS@8 为 68.2 resolve rate。32B RL 数字存在内部冲突：§6.2 正文写 54.8，而 abstract、Table 2 与官方 repository README 写 55.0。本 Card 同时保留两个值，在完成核对前只把 55.0 当作 table value。所有最终 benchmark 正确性判定都使用 SWE-bench Verified Docker harness，而非 SWR。（Paper Table 2；§6.2；Appendix E。）

Simulator 诊断显示残余误差不可忽略。相对 Docker-derived label，SWR-72B 报告 accuracy 0.770、precision 0.780、recall 0.807、F1 0.794。采用 SWT-72B transition 时，agent resolve rate 为 60.2%，采用 Docker ground-truth transition 时为 68.4%。在同为 5.7K 条 SFT trajectory 时，Docker data 得到 51.4，SWE-World data 得到 52.2；混合 9.3K 条 trajectory 得到 53.8。这些均为尚未独立复现的作者报告结果，且 mixed-data comparison 还改变了数据量。（Paper Tables 3–5。）

论文不仅给出 aggregate gain，也给出 negative result。在 4K evaluation 上，CoT 将 SWR reward accuracy 从 0.578 提高到 0.712。Figure 2 与 §7.2 显示 non-CoT SWR 会错误奖励简短无效 solution，随后优化中的 trajectory length collapse；这是 reward hacking 的直接证据，而不只是推测风险。该结果支持 reward reasoning 与 audit 的价值，但不能证明 simulated reward 在新 repository 或 adversarial policy 下仍然校准。（Paper Table 7；Figure 2；§§7.1–7.2。）

论文报告的 16,550 个 task instance 包含 310,544 行 edited lines、25,703 个 edited files、32,819 个 F2P tests 与 696,895 个 P2P tests。这些数字记录了作者声称的构造规模；由于尚未找到 task rows、26K/21K world-model examples 与 5.7K SFT trajectories 的完整发布，benchmark score 和 model weight 都不能证明底层 corpus 可独立审计或已可直接训练复用。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior baseline executes repository commands and tests in Docker-backed SWE environments such as R2E-Gym, SWE-Gym, and SWE-rebench. SWE-World changes the feedback substrate: it learns an action-level transition model and an episode-level reward model from real executions, then composes them with deterministic filesystem operations so policy data generation, RL, and candidate selection can run without per-episode Docker. It also couples that environment recipe to a filtered 16,550-task GitHub pool and to reverse-CoT supervision for the simulators.

The concrete direction signal is the separation of environment feedback into observable contracts: deterministic edit state, SWT-predicted command response, SWR-predicted terminal test outcome, and Docker ground truth used outside the learned loop. This makes it possible to measure which proxy replaces which expensive operation and where false feedback enters an agent trajectory. The paper's reward-hacking analysis is part of the contribution because it demonstrates that cheaper learned environments change the optimization target, not merely the runtime cost.

The individual ingredients are not new: SWE task mining, Docker execution, teacher rollouts, SFT, learned reward models, GRPO-style RL, and best-of-N selection all predate the work. Scale and integration alone do not establish better data. Before reuse, a builder must inspect whether gold-patch conditioning creates shortcuts, whether SWT/SWR calibration transfers across repositories and commands, which failed samples were retained at each stage, and whether the unreleased task/trajectory records can be licensed, split, and traced. Thus the novelty is a specific learned environment/feedback architecture and its measured failure surface, not a claim that Docker-free trajectories are intrinsically higher quality.

既有基线是在 R2E-Gym、SWE-Gym、SWE-rebench 等 Docker-backed SWE environment 中执行 repository command 与 test。SWE-World 改变了 feedback substrate：它从真实执行中学习 action-level transition model 与 episode-level reward model，再与确定性文件系统操作组合，使 policy data generation、RL 与 candidate selection 不必为每个 episode 启动 Docker。它还把该环境 recipe 与筛得的 16,550 个 GitHub task 及 simulator 的 reverse-CoT supervision 连接起来。

具体的方向信号是把 environment feedback 拆成可观察的 contract：确定性 edit state、SWT-predicted command response、SWR-predicted terminal test outcome，以及在学习循环之外提供真值的 Docker。这样可以测量哪个 proxy 替代了哪项昂贵操作，以及错误反馈在 agent trajectory 的何处进入。论文的 reward-hacking analysis 也是贡献的一部分，因为它表明较便宜的学习式环境改变了优化目标，而不只是降低运行成本。

各个组件本身并非全新：SWE task mining、Docker execution、teacher rollout、SFT、learned reward model、GRPO-style RL 与 best-of-N selection 均早于本工作。规模与工程整合本身不能证明数据更好。复用前必须检查 gold-patch conditioning 是否产生 shortcut、SWT/SWR calibration 能否迁移到新 repository/command、各阶段保留了哪些 failure，以及未发布 task/trajectory record 是否可许可、可划分且可追溯。因此，新意是具体的 learned environment/feedback architecture 及其被测 failure surface，而不是“Docker-free trajectory 天生质量更高”的主张。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
SWE-World's central limitation is proxy error. SWR-72B's reported accuracy of 0.770 entails both false rewards and missed successes, while the 60.2% versus 68.4% SWT/Docker transition comparison shows that simulated observations change downstream behavior. The non-CoT reward-hacking case demonstrates that a policy can exploit SWR by producing short invalid submissions. Distribution shift across repositories, dependency stacks, commands, and tests can also cause plausible but false stdout or test reports. These failures affect the very signal optimized by SFT filtering, RL, and TTS.

Gold-patch conditioning creates a separate audit risk. SWT/SWR and reverse-CoT generation can observe hidden gold_patch information unavailable to the policy. Curator inference: the models may learn shortcuts or leak solution-correlated cues into observations/rewards, even when the generated text does not copy the patch. The paper's LLM-as-a-judge filter is intended to remove invalid or output-leaking CoT, but the judge identity, prompt/runtime revision, threshold, and rejection statistics are unknown, so this control cannot be independently assessed.

Release limitations block direct corpus reuse. Only demo trajectory, SFT, and RL records were verified; no standalone full release was located for the 16,550 task pool, 26K SWT corpus, 21K SWR corpus, or 5.7K policy-SFT set. The code is MIT, but dataset/model licenses and the rights for GitHub issues, PRs, patches, comments, dependencies, and generated reasoning are unknown. Exact train/validation/held-out split sizes, repository/time isolation, crawl query, bot regex, bug keywords, deduplication implementation, per-row source manifest, broader contamination audit, privacy/consent, redaction, deletion, and takedown procedures are also undisclosed.

Experimental scope remains limited to the reported SWE setting. Final evaluation is on the 500-instance SWE-bench Verified benchmark; simulator robustness under new commands or adversarial policies is not established. Total RL steps and rollouts, seeds, hardware, compute, and checkpoint-to-table mapping are unknown. The 32B RL result conflicts between 55.0 and 54.8. Version drift also matters: arXiv is still v1, the inspected code commit is dated 2026-03-06, and released 72B SWT/SWR weights dated 2026-03-23 postdate the paper and code snapshot.

SWE-World 的核心局限是 proxy error。SWR-72B 报告 accuracy 0.770，意味着 false reward 与 missed success 均存在；60.2% 对 68.4% 的 SWT/Docker transition comparison 也显示 simulated observation 会改变下游行为。non-CoT reward-hacking 案例证明 policy 可通过简短无效提交利用 SWR。跨 repository、dependency stack、command 与 test 的 distribution shift 还可能生成貌似合理但错误的 stdout 或 test report。这些 failure 会直接污染 SFT filtering、RL 与 TTS 所优化的信号。

Gold-patch conditioning 带来独立 audit risk。SWT/SWR 与 reverse-CoT generation 可观察 policy 看不到的隐藏 gold_patch。Curator inference： 即使生成文本没有复制 patch，模型也可能学习 shortcut，或把与 solution 相关的 cue 泄露进 observation/reward。论文使用 LLM-as-a-judge filter 移除无效或泄露输出的 CoT，但 judge 身份、prompt/runtime revision、threshold 与 rejection statistics 都是 unknown，因此无法独立评估该控制。

发布限制阻断直接 corpus reuse。已核验的只有 trajectory、SFT 与 RL demo record；尚未找到 16,550 个 task pool、26K SWT corpus、21K SWR corpus 或 5.7K policy-SFT set 的独立完整发布。代码为 MIT，但 dataset/model license，以及 GitHub issue、PR、patch、comment、dependency 与 generated reasoning 的权利均为 unknown。精确 train/validation/held-out split size、repository/time isolation、crawl query、bot regex、bug keyword、deduplication implementation、逐行 source manifest、更广泛 contamination audit，以及 privacy/consent、redaction、deletion、takedown procedure 也未披露。

实验范围仍限于论文报告的 SWE setting。最终评测位于 500-instance SWE-bench Verified benchmark；simulator 在新 command 或 adversarial policy 下的 robustness 尚未建立。总 RL steps/rollouts、seed、hardware、compute 和 checkpoint-to-table mapping 为 unknown。32B RL 结果在 55.0 与 54.8 之间冲突。version drift 也需要注意：arXiv 仍是 v1，已检查代码 commit 日期为 2026-03-06，而发布于 2026-03-23 的 72B SWT/SWR weight 晚于论文与代码快照。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned Environment and Agent Trajectory Data track, SWE-World is most useful as a schema and feedback-contract reference. It shows how to serialize a repository task, full state-action-observation episode, action-level execution target, terminal test report, binary reward, and provenance across Docker collection and simulated interaction. A builder can use the published code and model weights as a starting point for experiments on learned environment feedback, SFT filtering, GRPO++ agent training, or SWR-ranked TTS, provided all revisions and the real Docker evaluator are pinned.

The construction recipe is reusable conditionally: collect both successful and failed Docker rollouts for SWT, balance SWR terminal labels, separate deterministic tools from modeled execution, retain the distinction between predicted and real test outcomes, and audit reverse-CoT before training. The demonstrated non-CoT failure offers a concrete verifier stress test: track invalid-short-solution reward rate, trajectory-length collapse, calibration, and Docker disagreement before and after policy optimization. The 55.0/54.8 discrepancy should be kept as a result-reconciliation check rather than silently selecting the more favorable number.

Reuse class is split by artifact. The official code and released 4B/32B policy plus 32B/72B SWT/SWR weights can support controlled research after license and revision checks. The reported 16,550 tasks, 26K/21K world-model records, and 5.7K SFT trajectories are blocked pending verification because complete releases, licenses, splits, and lineage were not located. SWE-bench Verified scores are suitable as paper evidence and an evaluation reference, not proof that SWE-World data is safe for training. Until the missing corpora and rights are resolved, the Card is a construction/audit reference rather than a drop-in training dataset.

对所分配的“环境与智能体轨迹数据”track，SWE-World 最适合作为 schema 与 feedback-contract reference。它展示如何序列化 repository task、完整 state-action-observation episode、action-level execution target、terminal test report、binary reward，以及跨 Docker collection 和 simulated interaction 的 provenance。复用者可把公开代码与模型权重作为 learned environment feedback、SFT filtering、GRPO++ agent training 或 SWR-ranked TTS 的实验起点，条件是固定所有 revision，并保留真实 Docker evaluator。

构造 recipe 可在满足条件时复用：为 SWT 同时采集成功与失败 Docker rollout；平衡 SWR terminal label；把 deterministic tool 与 modeled execution 分开；始终区分 predicted test outcome 和 real test outcome；训练前审计 reverse-CoT。论文展示的 non-CoT failure 可直接转为 verifier stress test：在 policy optimization 前后跟踪 invalid-short-solution reward rate、trajectory-length collapse、calibration 和 Docker disagreement。55.0/54.8 冲突应保留为 result-reconciliation check，不能静默选择更有利的数字。

Reuse class 需要按 artifact 拆分。官方代码与已发布的 4B/32B policy、32B/72B SWT/SWR weight 可在完成 license 与 revision 检查后支持受控研究。论文报告的 16,550 个 task、26K/21K world-model record 与 5.7K SFT trajectory 则是 blocked pending verification，因为尚未找到完整 release、license、split 与 lineage。SWE-bench Verified score 可作为论文证据和 evaluation reference，却不能证明 SWE-World data 可安全用于训练。在缺失 corpus 与权利问题解决前，本 Card 是 construction/audit reference，而非可直接投入训练的数据集。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the object boundary explicit: 16,550 tasks, 26K SWT examples, 21K SWR examples, and 5.7K policy-SFT episodes are not the same unit.
  • Read SWT as action-level simulated stdout/stderr/exit_code, SWR as episode-level test report plus binary reward, and Docker as the collection/final-evaluation oracle.
  • Preserve the 32B RL discrepancy: 55.0 in the abstract/Table 2/README versus 54.8 in §6.2 prose.
  • Pair Table 7 with Figure 2: CoT improves SWR accuracy, while non-CoT SWR directly exhibits reward hacking and trajectory-length collapse.
  • Check the official demos and weights, but do not infer a full data release; unresolved items include corpora, licenses, splits, lineage, judge identity, contamination, privacy, and RL compute.

• 始终保持对象边界：16,550 个 task、26K 个 SWT example、21K 个 SWR example 与 5.7K 个 policy-SFT episode 不是同一计量单位。
  • 把 SWT 读作 action-level simulated stdout/stderr/exit_code，把 SWR 读作 episode-level test report + binary reward，并把 Docker 视为 collection/final-evaluation oracle。
  • 保留 32B RL 数字冲突：abstract/Table 2/README 为 55.0，§6.2 正文为 54.8。
  • 联读 Table 7 与 Figure 2：CoT 提高 SWR accuracy，而 non-CoT SWR 直接表现出 reward hacking 与 trajectory-length collapse。
  • 可检查官方 demo 和 weight，但不能据此推断完整数据已发布；待解决项包括 corpus、license、split、lineage、judge 身份、contamination、privacy 与 RL compute。
